security_audit.summary: The skill is primarily documentation for using the RunComfy CLI with Wan 2.7. Confirmed risks are the intentional execution of external RunComfy commands and documented outbound API traffic; most static hits are markdown formatting or safe inline examples.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is required to use the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to install the RunComfy CLI only from the official package source and review commands before running them.

remediation.issue: Prompts, audio URLs, and generated outputs are processed by RunComfy services.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to send confidential media or sensitive prompts unless their RunComfy account and data policies allow it.

content.value_statement: Video generation requires precise model settings and clear motion prompts. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code prepare Wan 2.7 RunComfy jobs with useful defaults.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to choose Wan 2.7 instead of related video models.
Provides RunComfy CLI commands for Wan 2.7 text-to-video jobs.
Documents accepted duration, resolution, aspect ratio, seed, and prompt fields.
Guides audio-driven lip-sync setup with an audio_url input.
Gives prompt patterns for product videos, spokesperson clips, and vertical shorts.
Summarizes CLI exit codes and basic troubleshooting references.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and network access.
Wan 2.7 output is limited to 15 seconds and 1080p in the documented schema.
Audio inputs must meet the documented format, duration, and size limits.
The skill provides guidance and command examples; it does not include a local video generator.

use_cases.title: Create product showcase clips
use_cases.description: Generate short commercial-style product videos with camera movement, lighting, and negative prompts.

use_cases.title: Prepare lip-synced spokesperson videos
use_cases.description: Use a supplied voice track with Wan 2.7 audio_url settings for short spoken clips.

use_cases.title: Prototype vertical social videos
use_cases.description: Draft 9:16 prompts and RunComfy settings for fast short-form video tests.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a default Wan 2.7 video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wan 2.7 to create a 5 second 1080p 16:9 video of [subject]. Include clear camera motion and one main action.

prompt_templates.title: Create a vertical short
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Wan 2.7 RunComfy prompt for a 9:16 vertical short about [topic]. Include aspect ratio, duration, motion, and negative prompt guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Add audio lip-sync
prompt_templates.scenario: Spokesperson or dubbing workflow with a supplied audio file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Wan 2.7 lip-sync video plan using this audio URL: [audio_url]. Match the duration, describe the speaker, and include CLI-ready inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Build controlled variants
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced iteration with seeds and prompt expansion control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three Wan 2.7 prompt variants for [campaign]. Use the same seed for consistency, explain when to disable prompt expansion, and list expected tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: Create a product video for a premium watch on marble.
output_examples.output: A concise Wan 2.7 prompt with studio lighting, slow camera push-in, 1080p resolution, 16:9 aspect ratio, and negative prompts for flicker or text artifacts.

output_examples.input: Make a lip-synced vertical clip using my voiceover URL.
output_examples.output: A RunComfy-ready plan that sets audio_url, 9:16 aspect ratio, matching duration, speaker description, and notes about valid audio limits.

output_examples.input: I need multiple versions with consistent composition.
output_examples.output: Variant guidance that reuses a seed, changes one creative variable per run, and explains when prompt expansion should stay enabled.

best_practices: Use one main action per clip so the model can focus motion clearly.
Set aspect ratio and duration before writing detailed visual prompts.
Use concrete negative prompts such as no subtitles, no watermark, and no flicker.
anti_patterns: Do not combine many unrelated actions in one short clip.
Do not use vague negative prompts such as no bad quality.
Do not send private audio, images, or prompts unless third-party processing is approved.

faq.question: Does this skill generate video locally?
faq.answer: No. It prepares and documents RunComfy CLI calls for the hosted Wan 2.7 model.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What makes Wan 2.7 useful?
faq.answer: It is documented for text-to-video, multi-reference conditioning, smoother motion, and audio-driven lip-sync.

faq.question: Can I use my own voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented audio_url field accepts WAV or MP3 files within the stated limits.

faq.question: What are the main output limits?
faq.answer: The documented limits include a 15 second duration cap, 1080p maximum resolution, and fixed aspect ratio choices.

faq.question: What should I review before use?
faq.answer: Review the external CLI commands, RunComfy account requirements, and privacy impact of sending media to a hosted service.
